authorRole.en: Publisher of the student loan plan comparator (RAP, IBR, Tiered Standard, PSLF) and the 2026-27 SAI and Pell Grant estimator

authorDesc.en: Radif Partners builds free calculators that apply the 2025 student loan law (Public Law 119-21), the Department of Education's May 2026 regulations and the 2026-27 Federal Register notices to one borrower's own numbers: the Repayment Assistance Plan with its interest waiver and $50 principal match, Income-Based Repayment, the Tiered Standard plan, PSLF timelines, the student loan interest deduction and the Student Aid Index, each figure dated and linked to its official text.

description: Student loan calculator after the 2025 law: RAP, IBR, Tiered Standard and PSLF compared for your loans, plus the 2026-27 SAI, Pell Grant and interest rates.
